kind.value: Social media management platform covering planning and publishing, engagement and DM automations, reports, review management, listening and a link-in-bio tool

hosting.value: Hosted; a white-label setup is included on the Scale plan

pricingModel.value: Flat tiers, each bundling a set number of social profiles and users. Extra profiles and users are listed as customisable on Scale and Enterprise only, with no price published. X, listening and employee advocacy are separate add-ons

freeOption.value: No free plan. Employee advocacy is free to try and listening is free for your own profiles

trial.value: 14-day free trial, no credit card required; Enterprise starts with a demo instead

entryPaid.value: Professional, $99/month on monthly billing, 15 social profiles and 2 users

plans.value: Professional $99 (15 profiles, 2 users), Advanced $199 (30, 3), Scale $449 (70, 4), Enterprise custom (unlimited, 8+), on monthly billing. Add-ons: X $29/month, listening $75/month, employee advocacy $199/month for 25 employees
plans.note: The toggle opens on yearly, where the three plans show $80, $160 and $360 a month.

3.note: Professional is the cheapest plan and already includes 15 profiles, so 3 cost the same as 15. Add $29 a month if one of them is X.

10.note: Still inside Professional's 15 profiles, for 2 users. Add $29 a month for X.

30.note: Professional tops out at 15, so 30 needs Advanced, which includes exactly 30 profiles and 3 users. Add $29 a month for X.

networks.value: Bluesky, Facebook, Google Business Profile, Instagram, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snapchat, Threads, TikTok, Tumblr, X and YouTube. Review management covers the app stores, OpenTable, TripAdvisor, Trustpilot and Yelp

api.value: A REST API with endpoints across publishing, analytics, inbox and team management, included with Enterprise or an API add-on whose price is not published; other plans arrange access with their customer success manager

mcp.value: An MCP server included on all paid plans, exposing scheduling, analytics, inbox, ideas, media and reporting tools to assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor, following the user's own role permissions

ai.value: Metered by AI credits a month: 1,000 on Professional, 2,000 on Advanced, 3,500 on Scale, unlimited on Enterprise

teams.value: Users are bundled per plan: 2, 3, 4 and 8+, with extra users customisable on Scale and Enterprise only. Single-stage approval on all plans, multi-stage from Advanced, client profile connect and white label on Scale, SSO an Enterprise add-on
